task.description: Implement the validated ISS-0524 design: bounded single retry on empty wasm_hang discovery, header-anchored diagnostic window for the hard-fail message.

result.note: Added @wasm_hang_discovery_window_lines 300 and @wasm_hang_discovery_fallback_tail_lines 40. Rewrote discover_wasm_hang_tests/0: runs dry-run via new run_discovery_dry_run/0, retries exactly once on an empty first result (info log both attempts), a non-empty retry proceeds (info line noting recovery), a persistently-empty retry calls new raise_discovery_hard_failure/1 -- zero-tolerance policy preserved, function only ever returns non-empty or raises. New find_discovery_window/2 returns {:header_found, window, terminator_reached?} or :header_not_found, mirroring extract_test_list_block/1's exact header/terminator recognition via new shared wasm_hang_discovery_terminator_line?/1; retained last_output_lines/2 as the header-not-found fallback tail. extract_test_list_block/1, parse_wasm_hang_location!/1, run_single_wasm_hang_test/1, and main-suite/lua_wallclock_race paths untouched (confirmed via git diff). Tests: new describe block with 4 new fixtures (retry_succeeds, retry_still_fails, retry_noisy_window, no_header) via marker-file call counting, covering all design-specified cases. Verification: mix compile --warnings-as-errors clean; mix format --check-formatted clean (after one fix); mix test test/mix/tasks/letflow_check_test_test.exs -- 12 passed (6 original + 6 new); real (non-fixture) mix test --only wasm_hang --dry-run run 3x directly, header/terminator/span consistent with design's live measurement, all 5 real wasm_hang locations found on first attempt every time (consistent with ISSUE-FIXER's non-reproduction finding -- retry path covered by fixtures since not naturally reproducible live); mix test test/mix/tasks/ -- 216/218 passed, 2 pre-existing unrelated rustc-absent failures in letflow_check_toolchain_test.exs. Scope confirmed: no change to extract_test_list_block/1's parsing, no change to any real @tag :wasm_hang test site, no change to zero-tolerance-after-retry policy, no admission/try_acquire changes. SECURITY-REVIEWER out of scope: this touches only mix-task tooling and its own test file, no tenant-data path (no migration, no Ecto schema, no API route, no response shaping).
